€9U. (जानाति, जानीते, जज्ञौ, जज्ञे, अज्ञासीत्-अज्ञास्त, ज्ञातुम्, ज्ञात) 
__1 To know (in all senses), to learn, become acquainted with; मा ज्ञासीस्त्वं सुखी रामो यदकाषींत् स रक्षसाम् [[

.]] 
__2 To know, be aware of, be familiar or conversant with; जाने तपसो बीर्यम् [[Ś. 3. 1]]; जानन्नपि हि मेधावी जडवल्लोक आचरेत् [[

]], 123; 7. 148. 
__3 To find out, ascertain, investigate; ज्ञायतां कः कः कार्याथींति [[

.]] 
__4 To comprehend, apprehend, understand, feel, experience; as in दुःखज्ञ, सुखज्ञ &c. 
__5 To test, try, know the true character of; आपत्सु मित्रं जानीयात् [[

.]] 
__6 To recognise; न त्वं दृष्ट्बा न पुनरलकां ज्ञास्यसे कामचारिन् [[

.]] 
__7 To regard, consider, know to be; जानामि त्बां प्रकृतिपुरुषं कामरूपं मघोनः [[

.]] 
__8 To act, engage in (with gen. of the instrument); सर्पिषो जानीते [[Sk.]] ‘he engages in sacrifice with clarified butter (सर्पिषः = सर्पिषा). 
__9 Ved. To acknowledge, approve, allow. 
__10 To recognise as one's own, take possession of. -Caus. (ज्ञापयति, ज्ञपयति) 
__1 To announce, inform, make acquainted with, make known, notify. 
__2 To request, ask (Ātm.). 
__3 To sharpen. 
__4 To satisfy. 
__5 To praise. 
__6 To immolate, kill (as an animal). -Desid. (जिज्ञासते) 
__1 To desire to know, investigate, ascertain; [[

a. [ज्ञा-क] (At the end of comp.) 
__1 Knowing, familiar with; कार्यज्ञ, निमित्तज्ञ, शास्त्रज्ञ, सर्वज्ञ &c. 
__2 Wise; as in ज्ञंमन्य thinking oneself to be wise. 
-ज्ञः 
__1 A wise and learned man. 
__2 The sentient soul. 
__3 The planet Mercury. 
__4 The planet Mars. 
__5 An epithet of Brahmā; cf. ज्ञः प्राज्ञे चन्द्रतनये विषये चात्मगर्वयोः [[Nm.]] 
-Comp. 
-शक्तिः the intellectual faculty.

ज्ञपित,
ज्ञप्त a. Made known, informed, expounded, taught.
a. Made known, informed, announced, declared.

f. 
__1 Understanding. 
__2 Intellect. 
__3 Promulgating. 
__4 Satisfaction. 
__5 Sharpening. 
__6 Praise. 
__7 Immolating, killing.
a. Thinking oneself to be wise; निश्चिन्वते हि ज्ञंमन्या यमेवायोग्यमाग्रहात् [[Rāj.
a. [ज्ञा-कर्मणि-क्त] Known, ascertained, understood, learnt, comprehended &c.; आज्ञापय ज्ञातविशेष पुंसां [[

]]; see ज्ञा above. 
-तम् Knowledge. 
-Comp. 
-अन्वयः son of a known family. 
-सिद्धान्तः a man completely versed in any Śāstra.

pot. p. 
__1 To be known or understood. 
__2 Conceivable, comprehensible.

[ज्ञा-क्तिच्] 
__1 A paternal relation, a father, brother &c.; agnate relatives collectively. 
__2 A kinsman or kindred in general. 
__3 A distant kinsman who is not entitled to the oblations offered to deceased ancestors. 
__4 A father. 
-Comp. 
-कर्मन् n., 
-कार्यम् the duty of a kinsman. 
-चेलम् A low-born person; विभिन्नकर्माशयवाक् कुले नो मा ज्ञातिचेलं भुवि करयचिद् भूत् । [[

.]] 
-प्रायः A meal for kinsmen (Mar. जातिभोजन); प्रक्षाल्य हस्तावाचम्य ज्ञातिप्रायं प्रकल्पयेत् [[

.]] 
-भावः kin, relationship. 
-भेदः dissension among relatives. 
-विद् a. one who has or makes near relatives.
Relationship, an act befitting a relative; ज्ञातेयं कुरु सौमित्रे भयात् त्रायस्व राघवम् । [[

a. [ज्ञा-तृच्] Knowing, intelligent, wise. -m. 
__1 A wise man. 
__2 An acquaintance. 3 A bail, surety.

[ज्ञा-भाबे ल्युट्] 
__1 Knowing, understanding, becoming acquainted with, proficiency; सांख्यस्य योगस्य चज्ञानम् [[

.]] 
__2 Knowledge, learning; तथेन्द्रियाकुलीभावे ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन शुध्यति [[

]] knowingly or unknowingly, consciously or unconsciously. 
__4 Sacred knowledge; especially, knowledge derived form meditation on the higher truths of religion and philosophy which teaches man how to understand his own nature and how he may be reunited to the Supreme Spirit (opp. कर्मन्); cf. ज्ञानयोग and कर्मयोग in [[

.]] 
__5 The organ of intelligence, sense, intellect; कच्चिज्ज्ञानानि सर्वाणि प्रसन्नानि तवाच्युत [[

.]] 
__6 Conscience. 
__7 The Supreme spirit. 
__8 An epithet of Viṣṇu. 
__9 The Vedas taken collectively. 
__10 Means of knowing; औत्पत्तिकस्तु शब्दस्यार्थेन सम्बन्धस्तस्य ज्ञानम्° । [[

.]] 
__11 An opinion, a view; बलदेवस्य वाक्यं तु मम ज्ञाने न युज्यते [[

.]] 
-अनुत्पादः ignorance, folly. 
-अपोहः forgetfulness. 
-अभ्यासः 
__1 study. 
__2 thinking, [Page0744-2] reflection. 
-आत्मन् a. all-wise. 
-इन्द्रियम् an organ of perception; (these are five त्वच्, रसना, चक्षुस्, कर्ण and घ्राण-the skin, tongue, eye, ear and nose; see बुद्धीन्द्रिय under इन्द्रिय). 
-काण्डम् that inner or esoteric portion of Veda which refers to true spiritual knowledge, or knowledge of the Supreme spirit, as distinguished from the knowledge of ceremonial rites (opp. कर्मकाण्ड). 
-कृत a. done knowingly or intentionally. 
-गम्य a. attainable by the understanding. 
-घन m. pure or mere knowledge; निर्विशेषाय साम्याय नमो ज्ञानघनाय च [[

]]; तं त्वामहं ज्ञानघनं … कथं … परिभावयामि ibid 9. 8. 24. 
-चक्षुस् n. the eye of intelligence, the mind's eye, intellectual vision (opp. चर्मचक्षुस्); सर्वं तु समवेक्ष्येदं निखिलं ज्ञानचक्षुषा [[

]]; 4. 24. (-m.) a wise and learned man. 
-तत्त्वम् true knowledge, knowledge of God. 
-तपस् n. penance consisting in the acquisition of true knowledge. 
-दः a preceptor. 
-दा an epithet of Sarasvatī. 
-दुर्बल a. wanting in knowledge. 
-निश्चयः certainty, ascertainment. 
-निष्ठ a. intent on acquiring true (spiritual) knowledge; ज्ञाननिष्ठा द्विजाः केचित् [[

.]] 
-पतिः 
__1 the Supreme spirit. 
__2 a teacher, preceptor. 
-पूर्व a. preceded by knowledge, well-considered; निष्कामं ज्ञानपूर्वं तु निवृत्तमुपदिश्यते [[

.]] 
-बोधिनी f. N. of a Vedāntic treatise. 
-मुद्र a. ‘having the impress of wisdom’, wise. 
-मूल a. founded on spiritual knowledge. 
-यज्ञः a man possessed of true or spiritual knowledge, philosopher. 
-योगः contemplation as the principal means of, attaining the Supreme spirit or acquiring true or spiritual knowledge; ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेण योगिनाम् [[

.]] 
-लक्षणम्, -णा 
__1 indication, sign, a means of knowing or inferring. 
__2 (in logic) sign or proof of knowledge; subsequent derived from antecedent knowledge. 
-विज्ञानम् 
__1 sacred and miscellaneous knowledge; तत्प्राज्ञेन विनीतेन ज्ञानविज्ञानवेदिना [[

.]] 
__2 the Vedas with the supplementary branches of knowledge, such as medicine, arms &c. 
-वृद्ध advanced in knowledge; ज्ञानवृद्धो वयोबालो मृदुवींर्यगुणान्वितः [[

.]] 
-शास्त्रम् the science of fortune-telling. 
-साधनम् 
__1 a means of acquiring true or spiritual knowledge. 
__2 an organ of perception.

a. 
__1 Consisting of knowledge, spiritual; इतरो दहने स्वकर्मणां बवृते ज्ञानमयेन वह्निना [[

.]] 
__2 Containing knowledge. 
-यः 
__1 The Supreme spirit. 
__2 An epithet of Śiva.

a. 
(-नी f.) [ज्ञानमस्त्यस्य इनि] Intelligent, wise. -m. 
__1 An astrologer, fortune-teller; यदुवाचाग्निदाहादि स ज्ञानी भावि पृच्छताम् [[

.]] 
__2 A sage, one possessed of spiritual knowledge; आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थाथीं ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ [[
Den. P. To wish for knowledge.

a. [ज्ञा-णिच् ल्यु] Making known, teaching, informing, indicating &c. 
-कः 
__1 A teacher. 
__2 A commander, a master. 
__3 A master of requests, an officer of the court of an Indian prince; [[

.]] 
-कम् (In phil.) A significant expression, a suggestive rule or precept, said of such rules as imply something more than what is actually expressed by the words of those rules themselves.
[ज्ञा णिच्-ल्युट्] Making known, informing, teaching, announcing, indicating; क्षितिभृद्दाक्षिणात्यानां तिर्यक्त्वज्ञापनाय सः [[Rāj.
